abilities.name: Harder Than I Look
abilities.description: While your partner Digimon is at or below half of its maximum HP, it gains +2 damage on all attacks.

abilities.name: Shared Resolve
abilities.description: While Harder Than I Look is active on your partner Digimon, allied Digimon within 3 spaces of your partner also gain +2 damage.

abilities.name: Quick to Anger
abilities.description: Harder Than I Look activates whenever your partner Digimon is at or below 75% of its maximum HP.

abilities.name: Pure Heart
abilities.description: Once per encounter, as a Free Action, choose one Digimon within 5 spaces and make a Tame check against DN 15. On a success, that Digimon loses its next action. If it is not attacked before that action would occur, the GM may allow the scene to shift into dialogue rather than combat. Some Digimon hold nothing in their hearts but evil and hate, and opening a dialogue with something like that might be pointless; that's a call for the table to make in the moment, not a guarantee this ability provides.

abilities.name: Full Force
abilities.description: While Harder Than I Look is active, its bonus becomes +Sincerity to attack rolls and +Sincerity to damage rolls, replacing its normal +2 damage bonus.

abilities.name: The Mimi Effect
abilities.description: Once per encounter, as a Basic Action, activate The Mimi Effect. Until the start of your next turn, enemies attacking you or an allied Digimon take a penalty to their attack rolls equal to your Sincerity rank.
